name: the ground underfoot
plain: A picture at true size, of no particular place: 40 cm paving slabs with 8 mm joints, a 10 cm kerb, soil crumbs of 1 to 7 mm, grass blades 4 to 10 cm tall, grit, and a dew drop 2 mm across on the slab. Every position is drawn from a seed; nothing is measured or computed.

carrier.state: paving, kerb, soil, grass and grit of no particular place, at true size

basis.note: 'what the ground and the drop share, in metres, so the two rungs show one thing': the drop's radius, its height and the slab's colour are one set of constants

views.reads: the rung's marks at the zoom's metres per pixel

budget.quantity: what drawing a tile coarse may move against drawing it fine: the draw allocator's tolerance (Acuity, eps_px). It is not a bound on the picture's faithfulness to the holon.
